summary: Frontend-only testing of 4 items for Assicura CRM (tenant Schiantarelli). All 4 features/bug fixes verified end-to-end on preview URL: (1) 5-date cascade in DialogIncassoCopertura works perfectly, (2) Riepilogo documenti obbligatori mancanti banner appears correctly on polizza Documenti tab with count+list, (3) Sospesi search filters correctly by importo in both '1559' and '1559,00' formats while retaining textual search (contraente/targa/polizza), (4) TitoloDialog opens without JS errors and provvigioni are calculated correctly, no errors from /api/provvigioni/quota-collaboratore.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily toggled polizza-preventivo and anagrafica-passaporto to obbligatoria to verify banner; then disabled and saved to restore original state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 items verified. Date cascade test: open Titoli menu → Incasso/Copertura on a 'da incassare' row → both Copertura and Incasso checkboxes become checked when editing a non-coperto titolo, giving all 5 date fields. Changing ico-data-copertura cascades to ico-comunicazione-incasso, ico-data-contabile, ico-data-incasso, ico-data-coge; individual edits to the 4 do NOT ripple back. Banner test: in Librerie→Visibilità documenti, toggles have data-testid pattern vis-obbl-polizza-<key> and vis-obbl-anagrafica-<key>; after save, polizza Documenti tab shows [data-testid=riepilogo-mancanti] with [riepilogo-mancanti-count] and per-item [riepilogo-mancante-<key>]. Sospesi search handles importo both '1559' and '1559,00' formats. TitoloDialog loads clean (no JS/API errors) and shows Ripartizione provvigioni correctly.
